text: Taisho Pharmaceutical Holdings was taken private in 2024: Otemon, a Tokyo-based company owned by a member of the founding Uehara family and led by Shigeru Uehara, secured a 73% stake in its tender offer and moved to acquire the remaining shares.
short: Taisho Pharmaceutical Holdings was taken private by the Uehara family's Otemon in 2024.

source.name: JAKOTA Index News Hub: Taisho Pharmaceutical to Go Private in Japan’s Largest Management Buyout
source.quote: Otemon, under the leadership of Shigeru Uehara, has garnered significant control over Taisho by acquiring more than 60.03 million shares, surpassing the minimum requirement and securing a 73% stake
source.note: The same article calls Otemon 'a Tokyo-based company owned by a member of Taisho’s founding family' and says 'The strategic acquisition entails Otemon gaining full ownership of Taisho, with plans to purchase the remaining shares.'

additionalSources.name: Nikkei Biotech (日経バイオテク): 大正製薬ホールディングス、株式の上場廃止のお知らせ (Taisho Pharmaceutical Holdings: notice of delisting, company release)
additionalSources.quote: 2024年4月9日をもって東京証券取引所スタンダード市場において上場廃止となりますことをお知らせいたします
additionalSources.note: Nikkei Biotech reproducing Taisho Pharmaceutical Holdings' company release of 2024-04-08. English: 'Notice that the company's shares will be delisted from the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market effective April 9, 2024.'
